verdict.rationale: Codex documents both connecting to external MCP servers as a client (codex-docs-16, codex-docs-21/22) and exposing itself as an MCP server for other agents to connect to (codex-gh-6). However, the official 'codex mcp-server' interface is explicitly marked experimental and now deprecated in favor of an unspecified 'Codex app server' (codex-docs-23), creating uncertainty about the stability and continuity of this integration path.
